title: Ingram Micro Holding Set to Join S&P SmallCap 600
summary: Ingram Micro Holding Corp. (NYSE: INGM) will replace Pacira BioSciences Inc. (NASD: PCRX) in the S&P SmallCap 600 effective prior to the opening of trading on Tuesday, November 17. title: Ingram Micro jumps after securing spot in S&P SmallCap 600
summary: Investing.com -- Ingram Micro Holding Ltd (NYSE:INGM) shares climbed 4.8% in extended trading Wednesday after S&P Dow Jones Indices announced the technology distributor will join the S&P SmallCap 600.
